author: Ariadne I
title: Adaptive Dual-Decay v2 (k=160, H=96) + Curvature — Contextual m[b,k]
abstract: Scale Adaptive Dual-Decay v2 to k=160 with larger increment MLP (H=96) and stronger long-horizon gate (gamma_end=0.98). Keeps context-adaptive mixture m[b,k], per-factor temporal gating S[b,t,k], 2nd-order residual copy head, and MAE+curvature loss with global-norm clipping.
